can we use modern `std::tie()` instead ? 

```
    return entityIntf &&
           std::tie(entityIntf->containerID(),
                    entityIntf->entityType(),
                    entityIntf->entityInstanceNumber()) == entityInfo;
```
entityIntf->entityType() is not a lvalue to be referenced by std::tie. To do so, I guess I would need to save them in local vars?
Please re-open for your replies.
